meta.topic: Home and property gaps: household waste plans and bulky pickup, water heaters, cleaning consumables, property tenure and due diligence, outbuildings, lighting fixtures, gardens and pitches, home-improvement contract cancellation and change orders
meta.method: Each figure was read on the publisher's own page (curl text extraction, a page reader, or pdftotext on the publisher's PDF) where the entry says confirmed: true. confirmed: false means the figure came from a search-engine summary, a secondary site, or a garbled page, and the note says which. Nothing was estimated. Where a figure could not be found, it is listed in notes.notFound. Before writing, the existing files in docs/research/world/ were checked so topics already covered are cross-referenced rather than repeated (see notes.alreadyCovered).
meta.fieldConvention: figures holds the numbers as published; unit and currency describe them; url is the page read; date is the publisher's stated date or, where none was stated, the date read (2026-10-03), and dateKind says which.

waterHeaters.label: ENERGY STAR key product criteria, residential water heaters

definitions.firstHourRating: estimate of the maximum volume of hot water in gallons a storage water heater can supply within an hour that begins with the heater fully heated; measured at 125 F outlet
definitions.GPM: gallons per minute an instantaneous heater supplies while maintaining a nominal temperature rise; measured over a 67 F rise

waterHeaters.unit: UEF ratio; gallons per hour; gallons per minute
waterHeaters.note: These are certification floors, not typical-product figures; a game heater's FHR/GPM should be at or above them only if it is meant to be ENERGY STAR.

construction.label: UK Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 - off-premises and distance cancellation

figures.serviceContractCancellationDays: 14 days after the day the contract is entered into (reg. 30)
figures.goodsCancellationDays: 14 days after the goods come into the consumer's possession (reg. 30)
figures.ifCancellationInfoNotGiven: period extends to 14 days after the information is given, up to 12 months after the normal period ends (reg. 31)
figures.workStartingInsidePeriod: the trader must not begin before the period ends unless the consumer expressly requests it, on a durable medium for off-premises contracts; if the consumer then cancels, they pay a proportionate amount for work supplied (reg. 36)

construction.note: Applies to builder contracts signed at the customer's home or at a distance, not to contracts signed at the trader's premises.
